title: Image of the Week
content: Thanks toScientific Americanfor choosing “Décollage Nocturne” as their "Image of the Week."For those who haven't seen it, here is the blog series that followed the making of the painting in real time:Part 1: Initial SketchesPart 2: Researching Insect FlightPart 3: MaquettePart 4: LightingPart 5: Pencil DrawingPart 6: WashinPart 7: The PaintingUnveiling at the Jules Verne Museum-------Scientific American Image of the Week
